verses.original: יִשָּׁקֵ֙נִי֙ מִנְּשִׁיק֣וֹת פִּ֔יהוּ כִּֽי־ דֹּדֶ֖יךָ טוֹבִ֥ים מִיָּֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: yiš·šā·qê·nî min·nə·šî·qō·wṯ pî·hū kî- dō·ḏe·ḵā ṭō·w·ḇîm mî·yā·yin
verses.literal: Let him kiss me with the kisses of his mouth For your love is more delightful than wine

verses.original: לְרֵ֙יחַ֙ שְׁמָנֶ֣יךָ טוֹבִ֔ים שְׁמֶ֑ךָ שֶׁ֖מֶן תּוּרַ֣ק עַל־ כֵּ֖ן עֲלָמ֥וֹת אֲהֵבֽוּךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lə·rê·aḥ šə·mā·ne·ḵā ṭō·w·ḇîm šə·me·ḵā še·men tū·raq ‘al- kên ‘ă·lā·mō·wṯ ’ă·hê·ḇū·ḵā
verses.literal: The fragrance of your perfume is pleasing your name is like perfume poured out No wonder . . . the maidens adore you

verses.original: מָשְׁכֵ֖נִי אַחֲרֶ֣יךָ נָּר֑וּצָה הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ הֱבִיאַ֨נִי חֲדָרָ֗יו נָגִ֤ילָה וְנִשְׂמְחָה֙ בָּ֔ךְ נַזְכִּ֤ירָה דֹדֶ֙יךָ֙ מִיַּ֔יִן מֵישָׁרִ֖ים אֲהֵבֽוּךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: mā·šə·ḵê·nî ’a·ḥă·re·ḵā nā·rū·ṣāh ham·me·leḵ hĕ·ḇî·’a·nî ḥă·ḏā·rāw nā·ḡî·lāh wə·niś·mə·ḥāh bāḵ naz·kî·rāh ḏō·ḏe·ḵā mî·ya·yin mê·šā·rîm ’ă·hê·ḇū·ḵā
verses.literal: Take me away with you let us hurry May the king bring me to his chambers We will rejoice and delight in you we will praise your love more than wine It is only right that they adore you

verses.original: אֲנִי֙ שְׁחוֹרָ֤ה וְֽנָאוָ֔ה בְּנ֖וֹת יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם כְּאָהֳלֵ֣י קֵדָ֔ר כִּירִיע֖וֹת שְׁלֹמֹֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·nî šə·ḥō·w·rāh wə·nā·wāh bə·nō·wṯ yə·rū·šā·lim kə·’ā·ho·lê qê·ḏār kî·rî·‘ō·wṯ šə·lō·mōh
verses.literal: I am dark yet lovely O daughters of Jerusalem like the tents of Kedar like the curtains of Solomon

verses.original: אַל־ תִּרְא֙וּנִי֙ שֶׁאֲנִ֣י שְׁחַרְחֹ֔רֶת הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ שֶׁשֱּׁזָפַ֖תְנִי אִמִּ֣י בְּנֵ֧י נִֽחֲרוּ־ בִ֗י שָׂמֻ֙נִי֙ נֹטֵרָ֣ה אֶת־ הַכְּרָמִ֔ים כַּרְמִ֥י לֹ֥א נָטָֽרְתִּי׃ שֶׁלִּ֖י
verses.transliteration: ’al- tir·’ū·nî še·’ă·nî šə·ḥar·ḥō·reṯ haš·šā·meš šeš·šĕ·zā·p̄aṯ·nî ’im·mî bə·nê ni·ḥă·rū- ḇî śā·mu·nî nō·ṭê·rāh ’eṯ- hak·kə·rā·mîm kar·mî lō nā·ṭā·rə·tî šel·lî
verses.literal: Do not stare because I am dark for the sun has gazed upon me My mother’s sons were angry with me they made me a keeper - of the vineyards [but] my own vineyard I have neglected . . .

verses.original: הַגִּ֣ידָה לִּ֗י נַפְשִׁ֔י שֶׁ֤אָהֲבָה֙ אֵיכָ֣ה תִרְעֶ֔ה אֵיכָ֖ה תַּרְבִּ֣יץ בַּֽצָּהֳרָ֑יִם שַׁלָּמָ֤ה אֶֽהְיֶה֙ כְּעֹ֣טְיָ֔ה עַ֖ל עֶדְרֵ֥י חֲבֵרֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: hag·gî·ḏāh lî nap̄·šî še·’ā·hă·ḇāh ’ê·ḵāh ṯir·‘eh ’ê·ḵāh tar·bîṣ baṣ·ṣā·ho·rā·yim šal·lā·māh ’eh·yeh kə·‘ō·ṭə·yāh ‘al ‘eḏ·rê ḥă·ḇê·re·ḵā
verses.literal: Tell me O one I love where do you pasture your sheep Where do you rest them at midday Why should I be like a veiled woman beside the flocks of your companions

verses.original: אִם־ לֹ֤א תֵדְעִי֙ לָ֔ךְ הַיָּפָ֖ה בַּנָּשִׁ֑ים צְֽאִי־ לָ֞ךְ בְּעִקְבֵ֣י הַצֹּ֗אן וּרְעִי֙ אֶת־ גְּדִיֹּתַ֔יִךְ עַ֖ל מִשְׁכְּנ֥וֹת הָרֹעִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: ’im- lō ṯê·ḏə·‘î lāḵ hay·yā·p̄āh ban·nā·šîm ṣə·’î- lāḵ bə·‘iq·ḇê haṣ·ṣōn ū·rə·‘î ’eṯ- gə·ḏî·yō·ṯa·yiḵ ‘al miš·kə·nō·wṯ hā·rō·‘îm
verses.literal: If you do not know O fairest of women follow the tracks of the flock and graze - your young goats near the tents of the shepherds
I compare you my darling to a mare among Pharaoh’s chariots
Your cheeks are beautiful with ornaments your neck with strings of jewels

verses.original: נַעֲשֶׂה־ לָּ֔ךְ תּוֹרֵ֤י זָהָב֙ עִ֖ם נְקֻדּ֥וֹת הַכָּֽסֶף׃
verses.transliteration: na·‘ă·śeh- lāḵ tō·w·rê zā·hāḇ ‘im nə·qud·dō·wṯ hak·kā·sep̄
verses.literal: We will make you ornaments of gold [studded] with beads of silver

verses.original: עַד־ שֶׁ֤הַמֶּ֙לֶךְ֙ בִּמְסִבּ֔וֹ נִרְדִּ֖י נָתַ֥ן רֵיחֽוֹ׃
verses.literal: While the king was at his table my perfume spread its fragrance

verses.original: דּוֹדִי֙ לִ֔י צְר֨וֹר הַמֹּ֤ר׀ יָלִֽין׃ בֵּ֥ין שָׁדַ֖י
verses.transliteration: dō·w·ḏî lî ṣə·rō·wr ham·mōr yā·lîn bên šā·ḏay
verses.literal: My beloved is to me a sachet of myrrh resting between my breasts

verses.original: דּוֹדִי֙ לִ֔י אֶשְׁכֹּ֨ל הַכֹּ֤פֶר׀ בְּכַרְמֵ֖י עֵ֥ין גֶּֽדִי׃ס
verses.literal: My beloved is to me a cluster of henna blossoms in the vineyards vvv of En-gedi

verses.original: הִנָּ֤ךְ יָפָה֙ רַעְיָתִ֔י הִנָּ֥ךְ יָפָ֖ה עֵינַ֥יִךְ יוֹנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nāḵ yā·p̄āh ra‘·yā·ṯî hin·nāḵ yā·p̄āh ‘ê·na·yiḵ yō·w·nîm
verses.literal: How beautiful [you are] my darling Oh, how very beautiful Your eyes are [like] doves

verses.original: הִנְּךָ֨ יָפֶ֤ה דוֹדִי֙ אַ֣ף נָעִ֔ים אַף־ רַעֲנָנָֽה׃ עַרְשֵׂ֖נוּ
verses.literal: How handsome [you are] my beloved Oh, how delightful . . . The soft grass [is] our bed
The beams of our house are cedars our rafters [are fragrant] firs
